about.text: A hard, Emmental-like Turkish cheese, made in wheels of 60 to 70 pounds or more from cow's milk, or from a mix of cow and goat milk. It is said to have started in 1878 at Boğatepe, near Kars, when a Swiss cheesemaker set up a factory there.

sources.text: Its milk, look, wheel size and 1878 origin, from the article.
